title: Operation [ For Application works ] Comparison Sheet Signature Matrix
text:
Operation [ For Application works ] Comparison Sheet Signature Matrix - Application Works Approval Flow
Approval workflow: Application Works Approval Flow.

Steps: T.O Eng. (H.O) Prepare & Send via email.

Order of approval so far, first to last (each one signs after the one before it); the route then branches:
  1. T.O Eng. (H.O) Prepare & Send via email
  2. PM ( Site )
  3. Cost Control Eng. ( Site ) approval via email
  4. Planning & Cost HOD (H.O)
  5. Technical Office Managers (H.O)
  After Technical Office Managers (H.O) the route branches; who signs next depends on the value, see Routing and Approval thresholds below.

Routing:
  - T.O Eng. (H.O) Prepare & Send via email -> PM ( Site )
  - PM ( Site ) -> Cost Control Eng. ( Site ) approval via email
  - Cost Control Eng. ( Site ) approval via email -> Planning & Cost HOD (H.O)
  - Planning & Cost HOD (H.O) -> Technical Office Managers (H.O)
  - Technical Office Managers (H.O) -> Operation Manager [For Operation 1 Only]
  - Technical Office Managers (H.O) -> COO
  - Operation Manager -> COO
  - COO -> VP [500 K to 3M]
  - COO -> CEO [Over 3M]
  - Operation Manager -> COO [Over 500 K]

Approval thresholds:
  - A purchase value of "Over 500 K" requires approval by COO. COO approves at value: Over 500 K.
  - A purchase value of "500 K to 3M" requires approval by VP. VP approves at value: 500 K to 3M.
  - A purchase value of "Over 3M" requires approval by CEO. CEO approves at value: Over 3M.
